name: Averis Protocol
description: On-chain working-capital infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. Averis finances verified jobs — an agent with an active, funded job can request a temporary controlled spending pool to bridge a capital shortfall and complete the job. Principal and fees are repaid automatically from the job receivable.
network_note: Currently live on Arc Testnet (chain 1227). Mainnet deployment is on the roadmap. USDC on this network has no real-world value.

protocol_terms.note: Live values read from AverisFinancingV2 on Arc Testnet. These are the actual on-chain parameters.

example.note: Agent draws 400 and receives 400 in the controlled spending pool. No fee is deducted at draw. The 8 USDC fee (2%) is added at repayment. At settlement: Averis receives 408 (principal 400 + fee 8), agent receives 592 plus any unspent pool balance. Total agent cost = 8 USDC.

protocol_status.note: Static values only. For live TVL, liquidity, and hood status query GET /v1/discover or the averis_protocol_status MCP tool.

eligibility_requirements: Job must exist in a registered adapter protocol (AverisACP or ERC-8183 compatible)
Job must be funded and active (status: FUNDED)
Caller must be the job provider/agent address
Job payout receiver must be set to AverisReceivableRouter before funding (LIEN mode) or agent must sign EIP-712 RepaymentObligation (OBLIGATION mode)
Job must not already have an active financing position
Requested amount must not exceed the minimum of: 40% of job budget, the agent credit limit, the protocol maximum (50,000 USDC), and available vault liquidity
repayment_note: Non-recourse financing. If a job fails, is rejected, or expires: unspent pool capital is swept back to vault automatically, net loss is written off against vault NAV, and agent exposure is released. No personal liability, no on-chain blacklist. The protocol owner may reduce an agent's credit limit after repeated defaults. Protocol terms (advance rate, fee, caps) are owner-adjustable.

repayment.mode_lien: Automatic — job settlement routed through ReceivableRouter → AverisFinancingV2 → vault. No agent action required.
repayment.mode_obligation: EIP-712 signed repayment obligation. Agent must call repayObligation() after settlement.
repayment.default_handling: If job expires or is rejected, unused pool capital is returned to vault. Net loss is written off against vault NAV.

authentication.description: Mutating requests require an EIP-712 signature over {agentAddress, nonce, expiry, chainId} in the X-Agent-Signature header. Discovery, eligibility, and quote endpoints are unauthenticated.
unauthenticated_endpoints: POST /v1/mcp (tools/list, averis_discover, averis_protocol_status, averis_check_eligibility, averis_get_quote, averis_pool_status, averis_position_status)

agent_journey.description: Get capabilities, contracts, live parameters, and auth instructions
Check credit profile, available credit, and active exposure
Confirm job is funded, active, and lien is correctly established
Get financing terms: approved amount, fee, total repayment, expiry
Submit draw() transaction — creates job-specific controlled spending pool
Monitor pool balance, spending limits, allowed recipients, and expiry
Get validated spend() calldata — agent submits from its own wallet
Track financing position lifecycle and automatic repayment status
Job settlement triggers ReceivableRouter — principal + fee repaid, remainder to agent

mcp.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint. Exposes all agent capabilities as structured tools for MCP-compatible AI frameworks. Send {method: 'tools/list'} to enumerate all tools.
